mapper.select: select count(*) as totalUsageCount , count(*) filter ( where cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date ) as todayUsageCount , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_minutes)), 0) as avgChargingMinutes , coalesce(sum(cs.actual_kwh), 0) as totalKwh , ( count(*) filter ( where cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date ) - count(*) filter ( where cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date - interval '1 day' ) ) as diffUsageCount from charging_session cs where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date

select to_char(cs.actual_start_time::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as usageDate , count(*) as usageCount from charging_session cs where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date group by cs.actual_start_time::date order by cs.actual_start_time::date

select to_char(cs.actual_start_time, 'HH24') as usageHour , count(*) as usageCount from charging_session cs where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date group by to_char(cs.actual_start_time, 'HH24') order by usageHour

select c.charger_type as chargerType , count(*) as usageCount , round( count(*) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(count(*)) over(), 0), 1 ) as usageRate , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_minutes)), 0) as avgMinutes from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date group by c.charger_type order by usageCount desc

select row_number() over(order by count(*) desc) as rankNo , st.station_id as stationId , st.station_name as stationName , count(*) as usageCount , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_minutes)), 0) as avgMinutes , round( count(*) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(count(*)) over(), 0), 1 ) as operationRate from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date group by st.station_id, st.station_name order by usageCount desc limit 10
